items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I've never played with what I could call, what you call a real sad band... That was a fantastic bass player, Milt.

ctx.x: But, you know, Milt, I've been lucky. I've never played with what I could call, what you call a real sad band. I've never played with a sad band in my life. I've been that lucky.

Well, you've always been such a great asset to every orchestra you've ever been with. I don't know whether you know it, brother, but you are considered amongst musicians a musician's musician, a complete musician. And any band or any group of musicians that get together and talk about sidemen or instrumentalists they refer to you as the most complete musician. You certainly are the most knowledgeable one for this background that you have. And I want to ask you about that. How did you come about -- I know I've…
